What Luz kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The village's quarrel was with Luz — and Luz is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Klaus speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Klaus speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tomás.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Nora.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A mother from The Red Table pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 6,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
